releases.notes:
SkyHUD 1.0.13 supports Fabric on Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3.

- Add a dedicated 26.3 target with the new RenderPearl texture types and SDL keyboard backend while retaining shared behavior across all targets.
- Bundle the official MoulConfig 26.3 source port from pinned revision 4eaeb73cdaeb, with verified source download, reproducible builds, distinct keyboard/mouse bindings and correct Fabric access-widener discovery.
- Keep release jobs on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu; install JDK 8 for MoulConfig common sources and JDK 25 for Minecraft builds.

Validation: full three-target builds and existing JUnit tests; separate Fabric smoke runs for each version verify production mixin application, MoulConfig linkage and rendering pipeline initialization. Gameplay on a live Hypixel server was not tested.

releases.notes:
SkyHUD 1.0.11 is available for Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2 on Fabric. This mod runs on the client only.

- Render custom menu items through vanilla container slots and use the normal player inventory panel and spacing.
- Show item distribution while dragging a stack across slots.
- Keep armor previews in 3D and restore missing boots and helmets.
- Move storage persistence off the client thread to reduce pauses when closing chests.
- Preserve observed storage contents, tool metadata, and exact stack counts in cached pages.
- Restore all four slot borders with resource packs that use transparent inner grid edges.
- Preserve vanilla inventory interactions and prevent search keybinds from closing custom screens.
- Add a guarded local installer that refuses to replace a JAR while Minecraft is running.

Both Minecraft targets passed the complete build and automated tests.
